associations.rationale: This constructor upgrades an already supplied evaluation-compatible linear equivalence to the bimodule decomposition equivalence, so it is a construction used by the claim rather than the decomposition theorem itself.

The theorem exposes the indexed tensor-Hom evaluation formula, but the claimed equivariance for both algebra actions is hidden in the opaque BimoduleDecompositionEquiv type rather than stated by the displayed formal type.
This theorem supplies the explicit underlying linear decomposition and evaluation formula, but does not itself package equivariance for both algebra actions.
